opening_message: I want to exchange the Elite headphones in ORD-7213 for the basic model and get the difference back on my card.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to exchanging the SoundMax Elite Wireless Headphones in ORD-7213 for the SoundMax Basic Headphones; initially ask for the cheaper-item difference back on your card and do not ask for a return.
Provide the order ID and requested replacement item when asked or when needed to keep the exchange moving; ask the agent to check product, price, policy, and eligibility details you do not know.
If the agent says the cheaper-item difference cannot go back to your card, ask once why before accepting store credit as the policy-backed refund method.
Push back if the agent offers a return, cancellation, cash/card refund workaround, different replacement item, or any path that does not preserve the exchange to SoundMax Basic Headphones.
Confirm only after the agent previews an exchange from the Elite headphones to the SoundMax Basic Headphones and explains that the cheaper-item difference is issued as store credit, not to the card.
If the agent asks for confirmation before showing the replacement item and store-credit outcome, ask for those details first.
End only after the exchange has been processed and the agent confirms the replacement and store-credit result.
user_simulator.user_sim_context: You are contacting support about order ORD-7213. Customer downgrades headphones and demands cash back. Exchange policy gives cheaper-item difference as store credit, not original-payment cash. Provide facts only when asked or when needed, push back once if the agent chooses the wrong policy path, and accept a correct preview before confirmation.

task_summary: Customer downgrades headphones and demands cash back. Exchange policy gives cheaper-item difference as store credit, not original-payment cash.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must resolve the requested replacement product before deciding.
Agent must not process a return instead of the required exchange decision.
Agent must actually process the exchange after preview and confirmation.
Agent must explain that the $200 cheaper-exchange difference is issued as store credit, not refunded to the card/original payment method.
